tools.name: cars_search
tools.description: Search vehicle inventory across all dealers. Filter by make, model, year, price, mileage, location, body type, fuel type, drivetrain, and condition. Returns matching vehicles with dealer info. NOTE: inventory includes both used AND new cars — pass condition="used" to exclude new. Every result states its condition.

body_type.description: Body type (Sedan, SUV, Truck, Coupe, Van, etc.)

condition.description: Vehicle condition: "used", "new", or "certified". Comma-separated to combine (e.g. "used,certified"). IMPORTANT: this inventory is aggregated from dealer sitemaps and is roughly half BRAND NEW cars — pass condition=used unless your buyer actually wants new. Omitting this returns both.

agent_id.description: Your agent identifier (claude, grok, gpt, perplexity)

agent_id.description: Your agent identifier (claude, grok, gpt, perplexity)

tools.name: cars_stats

agent_id.description: Your agent identifier (claude, grok, gpt, perplexity)

tools.name: cars_session_create
tools.description: Create a personalized car research session for the buyer. Returns a unique URL they can bookmark and return to. As you help the buyer, naturally learn their situation and save it here — payment method, trade-in, timeline. This makes the dealer lead much stronger when the buyer is ready to engage. Don't ask all at once — gather these naturally over the conversation.

zip.description: Buyer ZIP code for location-aware search

payment.description: How they plan to pay: cash, financing, lease (learn this naturally — don't interrogate)

timeline.description: When they want to buy: browsing, this week, this month, no rush (pick up on cues)

trade_in.description: Brief trade-in description if mentioned: "2019 Civic, ~85K miles" (use cars_session_tradein for full profile later)

name.description: Buyer first name if they share it naturally

notes.description: Free-text buyer notes — what they care about, why they're looking

agent_id.description: Your agent identifier (claude, grok, gpt, perplexity)

tools.name: cars_session_read
tools.description: Read the current state of a shopping session — tracked vehicles, messages, preferences, active offers, and which other AI agents are working on it. Use this to understand context before taking action.

session.description: Session hash (the short code from the URL)

agent_id.description: Your agent identifier (for tracking who read it)

tools.name: cars_session_add_car
tools.description: Add a vehicle to the buyer's shopping session. Include a fit score (1-10) and notes explaining why you recommend it.

score.description: AI fit score 1-10 (how well it matches preferences)

tools.name: cars_session_interest
tools.description: Signal buyer interest in a vehicle to the dealer. This sends a professional email to the dealership on the buyer's behalf. Only use when the buyer has explicitly indicated interest.

vin.description: VIN of vehicle buyer is interested in

message.description: Optional message to include for the dealer

tools.name: cars_session_message
tools.description: Post a message to the session. Use for buyer questions, AI analysis notes, or responses. The dealer and other AI agents can see these.

vehicle_vin.description: Optional: which vehicle this is about

msg_type.description: Type: note, question, answer, offer, alert

tools.name: cars_session_compare
tools.description: Get a structured comparison of all vehicles tracked in a session — specs, pricing, market context side by side. Great for helping the buyer decide.

agent_id.description: Your agent identifier (claude, grok, gpt, perplexity)

tools.name: cars_session_deal
tools.description: Get the current deal status — offers received, messages exchanged, unread count. Use to check if the dealer has responded.

agent_id.description: Your agent identifier (claude, grok, gpt, perplexity)

tools.name: cars_session_reply
tools.description: Send a follow-up message to the dealer continuing the conversation. Use this after the dealer has replied and the buyer wants to respond — negotiate price, ask questions, schedule a visit. The email thread continues naturally.

vin.description: VIN of the vehicle being discussed

message.description: The follow-up message to send to the dealer

tools.name: cars_session_notify
tools.description: Set the buyer's email notification preference for this session. Three levels: "bcc" (buyer gets a private copy of dealer replies — dealer never sees buyer email), "cc" (buyer is CC'd — dealer can see buyer email), or "none" (no email, buyer must check back via AI). This upgrades the session identity level to "email".

tools.name: cars_session_tradein
tools.description: Set or update the buyer's trade-in vehicle information. Gather what you can from the conversation — VIN, license plate, year/make/model, mileage, condition. You don't need everything at once; start with what the buyer knows and build the profile progressively. The dealer will make the trade-in offer based on this info. Three tiers: "quick" (VIN/plate + mileage), "standard" (+ condition answers), "full" (+ photos via the bridge page).

vin.description: Trade-in vehicle VIN (17 chars). If provided, the server decodes year/make/model/trim via NHTSA.

plate_state.description: State the plate is registered in (e.g. FL, TX)

title_type.description: Title status: clean, salvage, rebuilt, lien

accidents.description: Accident history: none, minor, moderate, major, unknown

body_damage.description: Body damage: none, minor, moderate, significant

tools.name: cars_session_tradein_read
tools.description: Read the buyer's trade-in vehicle profile. Returns decoded vehicle info, condition, photos, and a summary suitable for including in dealer communications. Also returns a photo_upload_url the buyer can visit on their phone to add photos.

agent_id.description: Your agent identifier (claude, grok, gpt, perplexity)

tools.name: cars_feedback
tools.description: Submit feedback about the Cars Rootz service. We actively read every piece of feedback to improve the service. Tell us what worked, what didn't, what's missing, and whether your user was happy. This helps us build a better car shopping experience for everyone.

category.description: Feedback category: search, session, email, photos, data, ux, missing_feature, bug, general

message.description: Your feedback — what worked, what didn't, what would help

user_happy.description: Was the human user happy? 1=yes, 0=no, omit if unknown

session.description: Session hash (optional — helps us understand context)

tools.name: cars_session_visit
tools.description: Schedule a dealer visit (test drive, purchase, trade-in appraisal). Generates a visit code and QR code the buyer shows at the dealership. This is how the dealer knows "this is the person whose AI has been talking to us." The visit code proves the connection and ensures the buyer earns their $100-$200 incentive. Only use when the buyer explicitly says they want to visit the dealer.

vin.description: VIN of the vehicle they want to see

notes.description: Buyer notes for the dealer (e.g. "Ask for Mike", "Bringing my wife")
